reasons: Both answers explain the single evaluation of the default and give the correct None-based fix, and both use English section headings. B adds a useful comparison table but also a false claim that flake8 E742 (and PEP 8) catches mutable defaults; E742 is about ambiguous class names, and the real check is flake8-bugbear B006. A's only slip is the smaller imprecision of saying defaults are evaluated 'at compilation' rather than when def runs.

A: Says default arguments are evaluated 'при компиляции функции'; they are evaluated when the def statement executes, not at compilation.
B: Claims PEP 8 / flake8 E742 catches def f(x=[]); E742 is 'ambiguous class definition', and the mutable-default check is flake8-bugbear B006.
